title: TOP 10
subtitle: graphic novels every kid was obsessed with

lines.say: The ten graphic novels every kid was obsessed with. Ranked by how popular they really got.
cap: Ranked by how {o:popular} they really got.

lines.say: Ten. Amulet. A real fantasy epic, and the series that turned library skeptics into readers.
cap: the series that turned library skeptics into readers.

lines.say: Nine. Wings of Fire, the graphic novels. Dragon tribes, prophecies, and fan art in every notebook margin.
cap: Wings of Fire, the graphic novels.
and fan art in every notebook margin.

lines.say: Eight. The Bad Guys. Villains trying to be heroes. Short, fast, and big enough to get its own movie.
cap: The Bad Guys. Villains trying to be {g:heroes}.

lines.say: Seven. Dork Diaries. Doodles and middle school drama. For a lot of kids, this was the other diary.
cap: Dork Diaries. Doodles and middle school drama.
For a lot of kids, this was {o:the other diary}.

lines.say: Six. Big Nate. Not the biggest seller here, but thirty-five years of comic strips. The best crafted on this list.
cap: Big Nate. Not the biggest seller here,

lines.say: Five. The Baby-Sitters Club. An eighties series reborn as graphic novels, then a Netflix show.
cap: An {o:eighties} series reborn as graphic novels,

lines.say: Four. Smile. A true story about braces and growing up, and it stayed on bestseller lists for years.
cap: Smile. A {g:true story} about braces and growing up,
and it stayed on bestseller lists for {o:years}.

lines.say: Three. Captain Underpants. Potty humor that drove parents crazy, and kids lined up anyway.
Two. Dog Man. The spin-off that outgrew the original. New books launch straight to number one.
cap: Dog Man. The spin-off that {o:outgrew} the original.
New books launch straight to {g:number one}.

lines.say: And number one. Diary of a Wimpy Kid. Over three hundred million copies. Love it or not, nothing else comes close.
cap: Love it or not, {g:nothing else comes close}.

lines.say: And if your favorite didn't make the cut, it was either too niche, or it just falls behind these ten.
cap: And if your favorite didn't make the cut,
or it just {r:falls behind} these ten.

lines.say: So, which one did you read first?
cap: So, which one did you read {o:first}?
